appearances.title: DSpine measured faster than DFlash2 on Qwen3.8 27B
appearances.summary: In one local test, plain decoding ran at 253 tokens per second, DFlash2 at 590, and Tencent's DSpine at 686. Speculative decoding supplied most of the gain, and DSpine added about 16 percent on top of DFlash2.
